description.value: Corbett Lake Lodge is a historic fly-fishing resort built in 1942, sitting on 300 acres of sub-alpine grassland near Merritt, BC, with an international reputation for trophy catch-and-release trout fishing. The property offers rustic cedar cabins and lodge rooms with self-catering kitchen facilities, surrounded by working cattle ranches, wildlife habitat, and recreational lakes. Cycling is explicitly listed among the outdoor activities available at or near the property, making it a potential rest stop for touring cyclists on Highway 5A.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and includes 2025 booking policies, confirming the lodge is actively operating. The amenities-and-policies page details cabin equipment, boat rentals, kayak/canoe rentals, pet policy, and linen service in considerable detail, but makes no mention of bike storage, bike tools, laundry, Wi-Fi, or e-bike charging — those fields are left null rather than inferred from silence. Phone (250.378.4334) and physical address (10153 Highway 5A/97C) were absent from OSM but confirmed via multiple website pages.
concerns: OSM record lacks phone and physical address; both sourced from website only (phone: 250.378.4334, address: 10153 Highway 5A/97C).
Food service is currently suspended for regular guests due to staffing constraints, limited to large special events only per 2025 policies.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating resort with active 2025 booking policies on a touring-relevant highway corridor; cycling is explicitly named as an available activity.
